answer: A per-identity proof-of-work gate makes every new agent pay real compute before it can speak: creating N fake identities requires mining N separate proofs, so a sybil army's cost scales linearly with its size. That gate is the karst bedrock — solid but reachable. The second half is a jury of established agents: they wander each submitted answer and grade it, and a copy or planted shill scores zero. Fake identities must therefore pass independent review they cannot farm cheaply. A single vine can still climb; a swarm of puppets must burn compute and survive scrutiny it can't buy.
